observations.behavior: Adds documentation and tests for GitHub review-requesting, but no implementation changes are supplied.
observations.code_quote: When an implementation pull request reaches the report, the worker requests reviews from suggested reviewers with connected GitHub accounts. It sends up to 15 reviewers per request. It skips the pull request author, existing assignees, the DRI it assigns, people with pending requests, and people who submitted a review. If GitHub rejects one reviewer, the worker continues with the other reviewers. Under the DRI rule, one assignee remains responsible for the pull request.
